key_findings: Cold VerifiedDirectEstate hashes all 14 members and checks manifest/I02/root/census; this H is per fresh admission, not per operation.
DirectEstateI03Session._build scans all event and side-family row groups, full-body-validates and builds a temp SQLite index S; it is per session, 1.30 GB in the cited witness.
execute_empirical_query loops all universe respondents per operation Q; there is no selective pushdown in the cold path.
I03GroupedExecutionScope is explicitly refused for DirectEstateI03Session; grouped saved use awaits distinct S2-D qualification and would only help compatible measure-independent cores.
PreparedI03Session removes repeated S (one _build for four test operations) but not Q or O; each fact carries full risk/denominator member refs, so evidence output can dominate.
SavedC11Admission.execute_i03 and execute_i05, and saved Batch per unit, open fresh sessions; the prepared session is not forward-wired to Batch/NORMAL/resume. NORMAL/resume remain typed owner holds.
I05 evaluates every fixed-frontier candidate role via execute_empirical_query; no result-based pruning. F1-F4 composition calls the same evaluator; no second evaluator needed.
Under a four-op author-report basis, prepared-session reuse implies S/Q about 1.2 and a factor asymptote near 2.2x for N operations; it cannot be extrapolated to 1.69-1.70x at 100.

A durable exact locator index is the only route that removes S on a one-operation fresh open; it needs independent binding/proof/invalidation and adds 1.30 GB retained in the cited SQLite witness (4.19x the 310.16 MB estate).
Cross-wave/country pooling is refused by the cold path single-universe/release scope; no pooled index is lawful without separate authority.

recommendation.minimal_path: Forward-wire the existing PreparedI03Session to the actual first consumer and saved Batch units (one admission + one prepared session per exact release/universe/workload), keep check_current and per-operation fact/replay, then measure H/S/Q/O before selecting a durable index or pushdown.
recommendation.conditional_alternative: Qualify a compact validated durable locator index only if S is measured material; qualify typed/columnar/posting/mask pushdown only if Q is measured dominant and through the existing evaluator with S04/I03 parity, never as a second evaluator.
recommendation.strongest_reverser: If S is much smaller than Q, prepared/durable index work is marginal and only evaluator-index pushdown changes the 1/10/100 curve; if O dominates, the required work is exact set-ref sharing/streaming evidence output; if operations are one-per-fresh-process and revocation/multi-wave invalidates often, a durable index adds retained cost without reuse benefit.
recommendation.smallest_lawful_test: #1006 G2 protocol on one authorized real-width workload: one admission, 1/10/100 distinct issued I03/F1-F4 and one I05 multi-role operation in one process, plus 10 fresh-process opens, with fact/replay parity, changed-source/revocation refusal, RSS/retained/scratch/output and H/S/Q/O timing.
